description: Prompt and direct Runway (Gen-4.5, Aleph) — the control-grade generative video tool for camera moves, character consistency, and edit-grade shots. Use when someone wants "a specific camera move," "the same character across multiple shots," "to edit/restyle existing footage," "a branded product/ad shot," "film-style previz," "image to video with Runway" (animate a still), or names Runway / Gen-4 / Gen-4.5 / Aleph / Act-Two / Motion Brush / References. Runway generates clips; a human assembles/edits; audio comes from ai-voiceover; WoopSocial schedules/publishes. Below the ai-video router, sibling to veo-3 (all-round + native audio), kling (native 4K/multi-shot/motion), and luma (cinematic HDR/mood). Consented performances only (Act-Two); AI disclosure mandatory.
